uncited: Lighting-Specific Compositing encompasses techniques that modify the standard front-to-back compositing equation to incorporate lighting effects, multi-channel illumination, geometric boundary enhancement, and shadow handling directly into the accumulation step.

This family modifies the standard compositing loop detailed in [Compositing and Blending](2515-compositing-and-blending.md) by computing lighting-specific contributions per sample or per channel before blending them into the accumulator.
